resources.string: Foreground app sessions captured on this device will appear here.
Semantic search over your documents and memories lands in phase-2.
Capture, privacy and sync controls live here.
Shown while Second Brain records which app is in the foreground.
Foreground app sessions stay on this device until synced.
Records which app is in the foreground so your activity feed stays complete.
Second Brain reads foreground app sessions through the system Usage Access API. Turn on \"Usage access\" for Second Brain in Settings; without it, nothing is captured and this screen stays empty.
Usage access has not been granted. Open Settings > Apps > Special app access > Usage access, choose Second Brain, then Allow.
Runs the capture service and keeps the ongoing notification visible.
Banking, password managers, health and private-browsing apps are excluded by default.
Excluded apps are never recorded — not even as an anonymous or redacted entry.
Queued sessions upload in the background when a network is available.
